'''Paran "The Needle" Sin''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the military forces of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. She was stationed in the [[Glarus Valley]] as part of the Organa forces protecting the [[Panteer Refuge]] and besieging the [[House Ulgo|Ulgo]]-held [[Castle Panteer]].<ref name="TOR" />
